strength.excerpt: As they pass a larger mass concentration, gravity affects the leading satellite first, initially pulling it farther from the trailing satellite.
strength.note: The concrete sequence makes the satellite-measurement principle easy to follow.

weakness.excerpt: Those inferred shifts can reveal changes in groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers and ice sheets, as well as sea-level changes attributable to water added to the oceans.
weakness.note: The list shows the range of applications, but the piece offers little detail beyond this overview and ends without a strong takeaway.
